title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #15: Hueco Basin and Rio Grande along U.S.–Mexico border
description: Black-and-white oblique orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#15" with a north arrow at upper left. Handwritten labels include "U.S. MEXICO", "Hueco Basin", "Hueco Mts.", "Rio Grande R." and "Finlay Mts.", following the river valley diagonally across the frame. Vertical streaks run through the left part of the print.
